evidence.controls: Run exclusive-01 used one fresh pinned API-25 ARM64 r02 guest, four fresh private children, and identical 6640-byte control ELF ea13209ed405080c38ca2bf072de4ac12c6816f03eee8f7905ad8e5d6dc4e151 in cont/step/step/cont order. Child-initialized halfword 1 and eight sentinel status slots resolved writable private pages before tracing. The unchanged adjacent ldxrh/stlxrh pair stored 0 with at most eight attempts; stepped observation was bounded to 128 resumes. Source, fixture, tool inputs, guest manifests, pulled ELF files and complete raw index are pinned by experiments/guest-exclusive-control/results.toml SHA-256 627b1187a7ff0296e5c8dde61fb23396a767772ec02fc47e9e68071b20c2c49a.
evidence.comparison: Independent typed Kotlin verification passed using the source captured before execution. Both continuous arms succeeded on attempt 1 with status 0 and final word 0. Both stepped arms failed all eight stores with status 1 and final word 1; 66 step stops and one terminal BRK stop consumed 67 resumes. All arms reached PC 0x210fac with signal 5/code 1, exited supervisor 0, and terminated/reaped child status 9. Verification checked indexed hashes, ELF instructions, trace ordering, branch flow, relevant registers, terminal memory/status consistency, bounds and binary identity. A copied record with contradictory terminal word and regenerated index was rejected with exit 3. An additional read-only review agreed on the differential and its single-guest scope. Disassembly and verifier outputs are pinned.
evidence.preservation: No Sparrow installation, launch, device responses, stock edits, guest enforcement changes, host policy changes or physical instrument access occurred. Post-run APK and embedded native library SHA-256 values match the stock pins. system_server retained PID 1057 across root-adbd restart and all arms; enforcement samples were Enforcing. Package lookup was empty and process snapshots contained no Sparrow or Frida. Cleanup acknowledged emulator shutdown and separate post-run evidence found ports 5041, 5580, 5581 and 27043 free. No guest retry or runtime change followed the outcome. docs/research/guest-exclusive-control.md SHA-256 f94b4728b26944bb070fa47dc09c0885c8b893f93317120d80c9e767ba4f008d records these limits.
